comment: Intentional differences from prjump 0.2.2. Every entry needs a reason. See scripts/parity/README.md.

rules.reason: Phase 4: GitHub compare URLs open the 'Open a pull request' form (quick_pull=1, documented in GitHub Docs 'Using query parameters to create a pull request').

current/ambiguous-tag.reason: Phase 3 bug 2: a tag with the branch's name made the source heads/foo. Phase 4: warn when the current branch has no upstream, so the PR page is not opened for a branch the remote does not have.
current/ambiguous-tag.stderr: warning: branch 'foo' has no upstream; push it first: git push -u origin foo

current/empty-source-flag.reason: Phase 4: warn when the current branch has no upstream, so the PR page is not opened for a branch the remote does not have.
current/empty-source-flag.stderr: warning: branch 'main' has no upstream; push it first: git push -u origin main

current/main.reason: Phase 4: warn when the current branch has no upstream, so the PR page is not opened for a branch the remote does not have.
current/main.stderr: warning: branch 'main' has no upstream; push it first: git push -u origin main

current/slash-branch.reason: Phase 4: warn when the current branch has no upstream, so the PR page is not opened for a branch the remote does not have.
current/slash-branch.stderr: warning: branch 'feature/x' has no upstream; push it first: git push -u origin feature/x

current/unborn.reason: Phase 3 bug 3: the current branch is known before the first commit. Phase 4: warn when the current branch has no upstream, so the PR page is not opened for a branch the remote does not have.
current/unborn.stderr: warning: branch 'main' has no upstream; push it first: git push -u origin main

default/symbolic-ref-slash.reason: Phase 3 bug 1: a default branch with a slash (release/2026) was cut to its last segment.

url/altssh-bitbucket.reason: Phase 3 bug 5: altssh.bitbucket.org only serves SSH; the web page is on bitbucket.org.

url/https-port.reason: Phase 3 bug 4: the web port of an https remote was dropped.

url/ipv6.reason: Phase 3 bug 4: IPv6 hosts lost their brackets and the web port, which made the URL invalid.

url/ipv6-scoped.reason: Phase 3 bug 4: IPv6 hosts lost their brackets, which made the URL invalid.

url/notgithub.reason: Phase 3 bug 6: notgithub.com is not GitHub; only github.com and its subdomains are.
url/notgithub.stderr: Error: Unsupported host. Use --provider github|bitbucket to override.

url/ssh-github-port-443.reason: Phase 3 bug 5: ssh.github.com only serves SSH; the web page is on github.com.
